candidate.note: The commit that adds this file necessarily comes after the build, so it cannot appear here. sourceCommit is the tree the archive was built from; nothing outside release-evidence/ changed after it.

tooling.note: Xcode 26.6 is the App Store-accepted release on this Mac. Xcode-beta 27.0 is also installed and was NOT used for this archive.

toolchain.verifiedFrom: the Toolchain directory inside the archived Crabrix.app built from this commit

archive.note: An archive is development-signed by design; the App Store export re-signs it with the distribution certificate and flips get-task-allow to false. This is therefore NOT the shipping artifact.

appStoreIPA.blocker: xcodebuild -exportArchive fails with 'No Accounts / No signing certificate iOS Distribution found'. The distribution certificate is Apple-managed, so it needs an authenticated Xcode account session; no provisioning profiles are installed on this Mac either. Owner action: open Xcode, confirm the account under Settings > Accounts, then export from Organizer (or re-run the export).

screenshots.capturedFrom: a Release simulator build of this commit's tree on a freshly erased simulator; the device archive differs from it in signing and architecture, so their binaries do not share a hash
